title: Ship the fixed classifier bundle: optimized example list, rubric, and head
description:
## Scope
Versioned fixed classifier bundle containing evolving main rubric, optimized fixed labeled examples, decision-element classification tasks and a fitted head over model answers. One complete decision-model request per item where supported; no DSPy. Default fixed examples; per-target retrieval deferred.

## Completion
Existing component work and historical harness replays remain evidence for their limited scope. Shipping the reusable classifier requires end-to-end integration and restart/observable lifecycle acceptance in decision-flywheel-e1e92986-a121-410a-b8c2-fb467d6b3d88. Core owns fit/orchestration; no dependency on Jev-Flywheel proof-of-concept implementation. This replaces outdated ownership assumptions and component-only completion criteria.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Phase 1 core pieces landed: f7721c4 (FixedExampleList with per-label reserve and artifact support; objective='brier' with optional checkpoint probabilities; improve_example_list) and 6da5fd3 (example_list_from_policy). make test: 226 passed. The Evaluations harness runs F / F-rand / A-c+F against these APIs offline (S0 passed). Remaining: the Brier fallback question on its story and the ClassifierBundle story (Phase 2). Owner Q2: one Jev request per item; description updated.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Completion audit: all component children and required end-to-end reviewer milestone e1e92986 are now closed with current fake lifecycle specs plus retained authorized live execution evidence. Versioned request rubric, fixed labeled examples, supporting classification tasks, probability-feature head, calibration, cache dependencies, deployment and restart are implemented in Decision-Flywheel itself. Retrieval remains explicitly deferred. Closing this technology bundle milestone does not claim accuracy improvement or completion of separate scorecard UI/device acceptance.
